definitions.ask: Should the sase_gmail skill gain a narrow section teaching agents the Mac SSH draft recipe?
definitions.why: a plain `ssh mac bob …` finds no gog, and the skill currently forbids drafting outright

choices.label: Add the section (draft only on request, never send) and deploy it after the gate verifies the Mac
Leave the skill read-only; agents learn the recipe only from your prompts

definitions.ask: After you approve the gate, should the follow-up agent create the Dan Dowd and Samuel Lam Gmail drafts?
definitions.why: those drafts were your previous request, and drafting never sends

choices.label: Run `bob gmail draft` on both existing notes and report the stored previews; nothing is sent
Stop after verification; you ask for the drafts later

definitions.ask: Should the script delete the six old gogcli macOS keychain items once the file keyring is verified?
definitions.why: the keychain copy is already encrypted and keeping it makes rollback lossless

choices.label: Leave them unused as an instant rollback path (`gog auth keyring auto`)
Remove them after a y/N prompt so only the file keyring holds the refresh tokens
